spanish: Y vestirás a Aarón los vestidos de la santidad, y lo ungirás, y lo santificarás, y sacerdoteará a mí.

findings.issue: H854 is the preposition with before the garments; Spanish leaves los vestidos as a bare second object of vestir. The clothing relation is unchanged.

notes: 2ms clothe/anoint/sanctify, 3ms priest, and 1cs לִי match; Aarón and both object suffixes are kept.
